"One student can enroll in many courses" - "One-to-Many relationship",
"Many students attend many courses" - "Many-to-Many relationship",
"ENROLLMENT table" - "Resolves Many-to-Many relationship",

"COURSE.PROFESSOR_ID" - "Implements relationship between COURSE and PROFESSOR",

"Primary Key" - "Uniquely identifies a record",
"Foreign Key" - "References a primary key in another table",

"Composite Key" - "Key consisting of multiple attributes",
"(STUDENT_ID, COURSE_ID)" - "Example of composite key",

"NULL" - "Represents unknown or missing data",
"UNIQUE" - "Constraint preventing duplicate values"
